question: Does a large imbalance between squared positive and negative completed-bar returns across sixteen continuous US100 M15 bars produce a sufficiently frequent and double-spread-positive one-market-hour dominant-variance or counter-variance response to justify exactly one later standalone additive entry-prototype question that must subsequently face the whole six-strategy portfolio?

predeclaration_history_feasibility.purpose: Choose a new non-rescue matrix that does not reuse the corrected 2022-2023 generated-tick interval.
predeclaration_history_feasibility.source: Already-preserved cumulative Unit 030 agent logs and HTML model labels only; no opportunity economics were read for this feasibility decision.
predeclaration_history_feasibility.cumulative_prefix_method: Each later preserved agent log is byte-prefix-equal to the prior log. Hash and scan only the newly appended raw-byte suffix for that path.
predeclaration_history_feasibility.excluded_interval: 2022-08-01 through 2024-01-01 is excluded from every Unit 032 path because its detailed Tester record used generated replacement ticks.
predeclaration_history_feasibility.split_2024_caveat: The prior clean 2024 full-year path supports feasibility only. New 2024 H1 and H2 paths must each independently pass the full detailed-history gate before economic reading.

fixed_observer.evaluation_clock: At the first valid executable tick of each newly opened US100 M15 bar, inspect only sixteen returns ending at the immediately completed bar.
fixed_observer.valid_tick: Bid and ask are positive and ask is not below bid; executable mid is their arithmetic mean.
fixed_observer.continuous_history: The current bar and all seventeen completed close observations needed for sixteen returns must have exactly 900 seconds between every adjacent bar time. Session reopen and every other discontinuous boundary are excluded.
fixed_observer.return_definition: For completed bars k=1 through 16, natural log of close[k] divided by close[k+1].
fixed_observer.positive_energy: Sum of squared strictly positive returns.
fixed_observer.negative_energy: Sum of squared strictly negative returns.
fixed_observer.zero_returns: Excluded from both sign counts and both energies.
fixed_observer.trigger: While no observation is unresolved, trigger at the first valid tick of the new M15 bar when both sign-count minima hold and absolute variance imbalance is at least 0.35.
fixed_observer.dominant_variance_direction: BUY when variance imbalance is positive and SELL when it is negative.
fixed_observer.horizon: Resolve at the first valid executable tick after four subsequent US100 M15 market-bar advances, equal to one market hour without counting closed-market time.
fixed_observer.overlap: At most one unresolved observation. No candidate is evaluated while an observation remains active; a new candidate may be evaluated at the same boundary immediately after resolution.
fixed_observer.entry_prices: At trigger use current ask for BUY and current bid for SELL.
fixed_observer.exit_prices: At resolution use current bid for BUY and current ask for SELL.
fixed_observer.observed_cost_profit: Use OrderCalcProfit at 0.01 volume with actual trigger and resolution bid/ask prices.
fixed_observer.double_spread_profit: Apply one additional trigger spread and one additional resolution spread against each direction, then call OrderCalcProfit. This is the only cost stress.
fixed_observer.eligible_variance_day: A distinct server date containing at least one idle continuous evaluation with valid closes, positive total energy and both sign-count minima.
outputs: one row per resolved trigger with window end and entry times, sign counts, positive/negative/total energy, imbalance, directions, entry/exit bid/ask, spreads, market bars held and observed/double-spread dominant/counter USD
one summary row with eligible variance days/evaluations, finalized bars, valid ticks, triggers, resolved, unresolved and rate/tick/profit-calculation faults
start and end US100 visible contract-spec snapshots

tester_contract.model: Every tick based on real ticks

environment_contract.origin: One minimal physical pre-run copy of build-6140 Lab executables and cached US100 history/ticks into the family runtime; no Live or other-family runtime link.
environment_contract.required_raw_tick_scope: US100 monthly real-tick files 2024-01 through 2026-07 inclusive. The invalid 2022-2023 interval and incomplete 2026-08 month are outside every fixed path and outside the invariant.
pre_outcome_freeze: source, SET, INI and EX5 manifests
required copied US100 monthly real-tick file manifests for 2024-01 through 2026-07
visible US100 digits, point, tick size/value, contract size, volume minimum/step and stops/freeze levels
per_path_gate: HTML report labels the path 100 percent real ticks and Tester stops normally.
The path-specific newly appended detailed agent-log segment contains zero absent-real-tick, discarded-real-tick, volume-mismatch, price-mismatch or every-tick-generation-used telemetry.
Required 2024-01 through 2026-07 US100 real-tick file hashes remain unchanged.
Observer start/end visible contract specifications are equal to the frozen values.
rate, invalid-tick and OrderCalcProfit faults are zero.
resolved output rows equal the summary resolved count and unresolved is at most one.
environment_contract.database_housekeeping: Generic selected-symbol, symbols database, current incomplete-month tick or derived history-cache changes alone are telemetry, not invalidation, because none is an economically consumed fixed-path raw-tick invariant.
environment_contract.single_rebuild_allowance: If a required in-scope monthly tick hash or visible specification changes before any semantic output is read, discard the path unread, rebuild the dedicated runtime once from the frozen source cache and rerun the identical path. A second change closes the unit invalid without economic judgment. Detailed generation telemetry is not a rebuild condition and closes invalid immediately.

path_metrics: eligible variance days/evaluations, resolved opportunities and opportunities per eligible variance day
observed-cost net, wins, losses, profit factor and maximum closed drawdown
double-spread net, wins, losses, profit factor and maximum closed drawdown
fixed_aggregation.pooled_metrics: Concatenate the four ordered path books without compounding volume and calculate the same metrics plus path contribution shares.
fixed_aggregation.zero_profit: Neither win nor loss and excluded from profit-factor numerator and denominator while retained in opportunity count.

fixed_selection_gate.integrity: All four paths pass the environment and observer contracts.
frequency: At least 0.40 resolved opportunities per eligible variance day pooled.
At least 0.25 resolved opportunities per eligible variance day in at least three of four paths.
economic: One direction book has positive pooled double-spread net USD.
Its pooled double-spread profit factor is at least 1.10.
Its double-spread net is positive in at least three of four paths.
Its pooled double-spread net divided by pooled maximum closed drawdown is at least 1.50.
No one path contributes more than 70 percent of the direction's total positive-path double-spread profit.
fixed_selection_gate.selection: Select at most one passing direction by higher pooled double-spread net, then higher profit factor, then more positive paths, then lexicographic direction name.
fixed_selection_gate.passing_action: Retain exactly one later standalone additive US100 entry-prototype question for the selected direction. Unit 032 places no trade and selects no stop, hold extension, size above 0.01, portfolio priority or Live candidate. A later prototype must be identity-separated and a subsequent combination unit must retain and evaluate all six existing strategies with their opportunity count unchanged.
fixed_selection_gate.failure_action: Close with no realized-variance-asymmetry prototype question. Do not rescue with another return window, threshold, sign-count minimum, energy transform, price basis, bar period, continuity rule, overlap rule, horizon, direction subgroup, spread stress or period exception.

stop_rules: Commit and push this declaration before adding source, configuration or reading any outcome.
Before any MQL change, reread the authoritative source-topology discipline and current Lab baseline declaration.
Compile corrections are allowed before any Tester path; freeze the first 0-error, 0-warning source and do not tune from compilation telemetry.
Commit and push source, configuration and compile receipt before the first path.
Run exactly four serial paths, subject only to the one environment rebuild allowance.
Do not inspect partial economic output between paths except integrity and normal-stop telemetry required to decide whether the next frozen path may run.
Do not query, alter, stop or restart Live.
